title: The Ansoff matrix
caption: Risk rises as the firm moves away from what it knows: from market penetration, through product or market development, to diversification, where both the product and the market are new. The gym chain's four options fill the grid.
alt: A two by two grid. Existing products in existing markets: market penetration. New products in existing markets: product development. Existing products in new markets: market development. New products in new markets: diversification.
description: Existing products, existing markets: market penetration, a referral scheme.
New products, existing markets: product development, online classes.
Existing products, new markets: market development, gyms in Ireland.
New products, new markets: diversification, protein snacks, the riskiest.
